# Source notice

The TWOSIDE notes and bk2b.py are byte-identical excerpts from
DreamingOfClouds's PR3154 at 708f0ad8928c383de8294aea3c126e9461d2066d.
They retain the original reduction and predecessor credit. PR3161-PROOF.md
is Nick Petalas's proof from PR3161 at a1aba8389b87412e6f72ccf4d11f31e0ea232327.
All are Apache-2.0, with the repository license retained here.

The successor's census.cpp reuses PR3161's flat enumeration, orbit machinery
and dual-code deletion oracle. geometry.py reuses its root/label reconstruction.
The new work adds Weyl-chamber direction completeness, signed-Gram symmetry,
exact rational-span accounting and the ten-deletion beta application.
UPSTREAM.json records the original paths, commits, blobs and hashes.
